Learn the basics

Two useful references to keep nearby as you practice.

Learn to trade for yourself

We don't believe in relying on copy trading or someone else's signals. We believe in learning to read and analyse charts, understand the market, and make your own trading decisions. The goal is to build your own skills, not depend on someone else to tell you when to trade.

Follow these steps

Start with a demo account. Open each step as you go.

01

Sign up for TradingView

+

Create an account on TradingView to view charts.

02

Sign up with Blueberry Markets

+

Create an account with Blueberry Markets .

03

Open a trading account

+

Choose a demo or live account. Start with demo so you can practice without risking money.

04

Connect to TradingView

+

Open the Trading Panel in TradingView, find your broker if it's supported, and sign in.

05

Try placing trades

+

Pick a forex pair, look at the chart, and practice placing demo trades.

06

Check the news

+

Use Forex Factory to see upcoming news that could move the market.

07

Track your trades

+

Record your trades in Pipfolio so you can see what went well and what didn't.

08

Keep learning

+

Read The Candlestick Trading Bible and use the Candlestick Patterns Cheat Sheet anytime to help you understand charts.
